summary: Reproduced the user's bug report end-to-end in the real browser SPA. FOUNDER (socialchutneylab@gmail.com / Chutney@2026) is correctly recognized as role=founder in the frontend: GET /api/auth/me returned 200 with role=founder on initial load AND after a hard page reload of /goals; AuthContext.isFounder evaluates true; add-goal-button is visible on both tabs; the 'Only the founder/manager can add or edit goals.' note is NOT rendered. ADD flow: POST /api/goals returned 200 and the new goal 'TEST_Doctor Pitching' appeared in Master List immediately. EDIT flow: PUT /api/goals/<id> returned 200 (target updated 10 -> 20). No 401/403 observed during the founder flow at any point. DESIGNER (designer@socialchutneyco.com / Design@2026): add-goal-button correctly absent, note correctly shown — expected behavior. Conclusion: the reported bug ('founder cannot add in Master List & Allocation; sees designer-only note') is NOT reproducible in the current build. The user was almost certainly logged in as the Designer account (or had a stale designer session) when they filed the report — the Designer sidebar shows 'Designer / Designer' which is easy to miss. No code fix needed.

issues: React a11y warning persists: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' (also flagged in iteration_6). Non-blocking.

action_items: No functional fix required for the reported bug. Optional: surface the current user's role more prominently in the sidebar (e.g., a role chip beside the name) so users can immediately see whether they are logged in as Founder or Designer and avoid this type of self-reported confusion.
(Carry-over minor) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to goal + task dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext correctly re-hydrates user via GET /api/auth/me on mount; httpOnly cookie persists across reload; isFounder = user.role === 'founder' works as designed.
Goals.js gating is clean: add-goal-button, edit/delete columns, and the designer-only note are all gated on the same isFounder flag — no divergence.
api.js refresh interceptor correctly excludes /auth/me, /auth/login, /auth/refresh — prevents the refresh-loop that could otherwise mask role on reload.
Backend require_founder returns 403 as expected; founder POST/PUT /api/goals returned 200 throughout the live run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (founder add+edit works; designer correctly view-only; auth/me stable across reload)

test_credentials: Founder: socialchutneylab@gmail.com / Chutney@2026 | Designer: designer@socialchutneyco.com / Design@2026
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ goal during E2E; deleted via API after the run (verified /api/goals returns no TEST_ rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Goals.js founder/designer gating is confirmed working. If the user re-reports the same bug, FIRST ask them to open DevTools Network tab, hit /api/auth/me, and share the role value — it will be 'designer' in the failure case. Also check the sidebar footer: it labels the account (Founder vs Designer). The backend require_founder path is correctly guarded and already covered by /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: user was signed in as the Designer account (role=designer), not the Founder. The 'Only the founder/manager can add or edit goals.' note and the hidden add-goal-button are the correct, intended UX for a designer. REPRODUCTION STEPS attempted on the live preview: (1) logged in via /login as socialchutneylab@gmail.com, (2) navigated to /goals, (3) opened Master List & Allocation tab, (4) clicked New Goal, filled name+target, saved — observed POST /api/goals 200 and the new row rendered; (5) edited the goal — observed PUT /api/goals/<id> 200; (6) hard-reloaded the page — GET /api/auth/me 200 role=founder, add button still visible. MITIGATION: no code change required. Advise the user to confirm the sidebar footer label and/or inspect /api/auth/me. Optional UX improvement: add a role badge next to the user name in the sidebar so Founder vs Designer is unmistakable at a glance.
